# Every test the default run does not run, why, and what runs it instead.
#
# The default run is `cargo test --locked --workspace`, and a test carrying
# `#[ignore]` is not in it. That attribute is one line, it is invisible in a
# green run, and nothing in the tree reads it, so a test can leave the default
# suite and be run by nothing at all without a single check going red. This file
# is the other half: the set is written down, and
# `.github/scripts/check-excluded-from-the-default-run.sh` refuses a difference
# between what is written here and what the sources carry.
#
# The pair with `.github/scripts/needs-an-environment.txt` is the point rather
# than a convenience. That register says what cannot be proved in the default
# suite; this one says what was taken out of it. A test named here whose
# `Runs-in` matches no entry there is a test that runs nowhere, and it is the
# failure this file exists against.
#
# `docs/excluded-from-the-default-run.md` argues the rule and says what the
# checker cannot judge, which is the larger half.
#
# One record per test, separated by a blank line. Four fields, all required:
#
#   Test     the test function's name, which is what `cargo test -- --exact`
#            takes and what a failure reports
#   In       the source it is written in, from the repository root
#   Because  why it is not in the default run, in one sentence
#   Runs-in  the `Id` of the `.github/scripts/needs-an-environment.txt` entry
#            that does run it
#
# A record with no `Test` or no `In` stops the run, because a record naming no
# test is not a record and judging the file around one would report a clean
# register that is not one. A record with no `Because` or no `Runs-in` is
# refused, because those two are the whole reason this file exists: a test
# nobody can argue for and a test nobody runs are the two ways an exclusion
# becomes a deletion.

Test: probe_a_display_server_is_reachable
In: crates/model/tests/environment.rs
Because: it asserts that a display server IS reachable and the gate reads its failure as the proof that the sealed environment has none, so a suite that must pass cannot hold a test written to fail.
Runs-in: sealed-probes

Test: probe_the_host_has_fonts_installed
In: crates/model/tests/environment.rs
Because: it asserts that the host has a font file installed, which is the thing the sealed environment is built without, so it is inverted in the same way and for the same reason as the probe above.
Runs-in: sealed-probes

Test: probe_a_network_socket_can_be_opened
In: crates/model/tests/environment.rs
Because: it opens a socket to a literal address, which is both an assertion the sealed environment must falsify and the one thing no test in the default suite may do.
Runs-in: sealed-probes

Test: probe_a_file_can_be_written_outside_the_scratch_directory
In: crates/model/tests/environment.rs
Because: it writes outside the path the run made for itself, which the default suite forbids, and it needs a machine whose calling user may write there, which a contributor's account usually may not.
Runs-in: sealed-probes
